rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for an attempt to find something.

example.english: The police launched a search for the missing person.
example.traditional: 警方展開搜索，尋找失蹤人士。
example.jyutping: ging2 fong1 zin2 hoi1 sau1 sok3 cam4 zaau2 sat1 zung1 jan4 si6

rows.note: Use 搵 as the all-purpose spoken verb for looking for something, including searching around a place.

example.english: I had to search around for an hour before I found the book.
example.traditional: 我周圍搵咗成個鐘先搵到本書。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zau1 wai4 wan2 zo2 seng4 go3 zung1 sin1 wan2 dou2 bun2 syu1

rows.note: Use 搜查 when thoroughly inspecting a place or person, especially in an official or police investigation.

example.english: The police had to search the whole house and found a batch of drugs.
example.traditional: 警察搜查咗成間屋，搵到一批毒品。
example.jyutping: ging2 caat3 sau1 caa4 zo2 seng4 gaan1 uk1 wan2 dou2 jat1 pai1 duk6 ban2
